name: sct
description: Local projects and encrypted handoffs for macOS.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.node.json && bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.typecheck:tsc: bun node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && bun node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.test:ui: bun run build && cd tests && playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts
